general: Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the query. Leave other text unlabelled.
E1 Label disorders: diseases, injuries, infections, tumours, signs, symptoms and abnormal findings, also when written as an adjective.

E2 Never label tests, measurements or their results ("BP", "pulse", "temperature", "haemoglobin 10.9 g / dl", "liver enzymes"), procedures and treatments ("oesophageo-gastro-duodenoscopy", "coronary artery bypass grafting", "surgery", "antibiotics", "prednisolone"), body parts on their own ("mucosa", "knees"), or habits ("alcohol use").
E3 Label a disorder also when it is negated or absent, leaving out the negating word.
E4 A mention is the disorder phrase itself, usually one to three words. Never label a clause, a sentence or a description of an examination or of a procedure.

classes.name: ClinicalEntity
classes.description: A definite pathologic process with a characteristic set of signs and symptoms.
rules: CE1 Common disorder words are mentions on their own: "fever", "tumor", "cyst", "lesions", "headache", "diabetic".
CE2 Leave out a leading word that gives side, size or severity: label "pitting oedema", "hepatomegaly", "VI nerve palsy", "ovarian cyst".
CE3 Keep a following phrase that says where the disorder is: "tinnitus in the right ear", "pain behind both eyes", "hyperemia of nasal mucosa".
